title: Attribute
text:
Strength, dexterity, and intelligence are attributes. Attributes are often requirements of gems and equipment. Characters gain inherent bonuses from attributes.
Attributes can be obtained either through items or through the passive skill tree.


== Mechanics ==
Strength is required to equip most equipment that grants Armour, as well as various melee-aligned Weapons and Skills. Every 1 Strength grants +2 Life. 
Dexterity, is required to use most equipment that grants Evasion Rating, as well as various range-aligned Weapons and Skills. Every 1 Dexterity grants +6 Accuracy Rating. 
Intelligence is required to use most equipment that grants Energy Shield, as well as various spell-aligned Weapons and Skills. Every 1 Intelligence grants +2 Mana.
